## Stage 0–1 build, runtime, and test dependencies

The lockfiles contain additional libraries used to build and test Stage 0 and Stage 1, including Jackson (Apache-2.0), JUnit (EPL-2.0), AJV (MIT), Zod (MIT), and TypeScript (Apache-2.0). Stage 1's Local Web also uses React/React DOM (MIT), Vite and its React plugin (MIT), Tailwind CSS and its Vite plugin (MIT), Radix Alert Dialog, Collapsible, and Slot primitives (MIT), prompt-kit source components (MIT), class-variance-authority (Apache-2.0), clsx (MIT), tailwind-merge (MIT), and Lucide React (ISC). Browser and accessibility verification use Playwright (Apache-2.0), axe-core (MPL-2.0), Testing Library (MIT), Vitest (MIT), and jsdom (MIT).

Their pinned versions and transitive dependencies are authoritative in `gradle.lockfile` files and `pnpm-lock.yaml`; distribution must reproduce complete dependency license reports from those lockfiles.

## Stage 0–1 build, runtime, and test dependencies

The lockfiles contain additional libraries used to build and test Stage 0 through the current Stage 2 work, including Jackson (Apache-2.0), JUnit (EPL-2.0), AJV (MIT), Zod (MIT), TypeScript (Apache-2.0), and Xerial SQLite JDBC (Apache-2.0). Stage 1's Local Web also uses React/React DOM (MIT), Vite and its React plugin (MIT), Tailwind CSS and its Vite plugin (MIT), Radix Alert Dialog, Collapsible, and Slot primitives (MIT), prompt-kit source components (MIT), class-variance-authority (Apache-2.0), clsx (MIT), tailwind-merge (MIT), and Lucide React (ISC). Browser and accessibility verification use Playwright (Apache-2.0), axe-core (MPL-2.0), Testing Library (MIT), Vitest (MIT), and jsdom (MIT).

Their pinned versions and transitive dependencies are authoritative in `gradle.lockfile` files and `pnpm-lock.yaml`; distribution must reproduce complete dependency license reports from those lockfiles.
